technical_quality: Adequate PA film; good inspiration on the left, midline trachea, no rotation, well penetrated; "L" side marker and "H8" label present in the upper-right image corner confirming conventional orientation. Right hemidiaphragm elevated, which limits assessment of the right base.

devices.type: radiographic side marker (L) with label H8 - external artifact
devices.location: upper-right corner of image, over the patient's left shoulder region (outside the thorax)

abnormalities.finding: Coarse reticular/linear opacities with a few small nodular densities extending from the right hilum inferiorly along the right heart border to the right cardiophrenic region - fibrotic scarring (labelled finding), approx 5 x 8 cm area
Elevated right hemidiaphragm (dome at approximately the anterior 4th-5th rib level), suggesting right basal volume loss
Small dense round nodule (~0.5 cm) just below the right clavicle, most consistent with a calcified granuloma
Small dense (possibly calcified) hilar nodal densities at both hila, more conspicuous on the left - likely old granulomatous disease
Mild prominence/unfolding of the aortic knob; heart size within normal limits (CTR approximately 0.35-0.4)

description_zh: PA 胸部X光，影像右上角可見「L」側別標記，方向為常規。右側肺門下方及右下肺野內側可見粗糙網狀、線狀併少數小結節狀陰影，沿右心緣向下延伸至右心橫膈角，範圍約5×8公分，符合局部纖維化／瘢痕變化；右側橫膈明顯上抬，可能伴隨右下肺容積減少。右上肺野鎖骨下方另見一約0.5公分之高密度小結節，雙側肺門亦有小的高密度（疑鈣化）結節影，疑為舊有肉芽腫性病變；主動脈弓輕微突出。左肺野大致清晰，心臟大小正常，未見肋膜積液、氣胸，亦未見任何導管、引流管或心律調節器等裝置。
